items.title: Trust Me Bro Then Websites Went Offline  (The php2shell story) | Threat Wire
items.summary: How did one mysterious Hacker News post saying “Trust me bro” trigger a global cybersecurity panic and send major websites offline? In this episode of Threat Wire, we break down the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities, the race to uncover remote code execution (RCE) exploits, fake proof-of-concept attacks, and the emergency security patches that followed. From millions of vulnerable internet services to leaked exploits and a controversial disclosure by Chainguard, discover how one warning sent the cybersecurity community into chaos. ⬇️ OPEN FOR LINKS items.summary_html:
How did one mysterious Hacker News post saying “Trust me bro” trigger a global cybersecurity panic and send major websites offline? In this episode of Threat Wire, we break down the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities, the race to uncover remote code execution (RCE) exploits, fake proof-of-concept attacks, and the emergency security patches that followed. From millions of vulnerable internet services to leaked exploits and a controversial disclosure by Chainguard, discover how one warning sent the cybersecurity community into chaos.
